title: Bound and disambiguate Kimi question choice labels
outcome: Kimi choice labels and option counts have sensible input bounds, and equal visible labels cannot leave the user guessing which choice is being sent.
acceptance: The Kimi permission question adapter bounds choice label size/control characters and option count using appropriate existing input-bound conventions, with an explicit refusal or display policy for exceeded bounds.

Equal labels are either refused visibly or distinguished in the rendered UI while exact offered option IDs and unmodified ordinary tool approval semantics are preserved; behavioral tests exercise the selected policy.
